what_this_proves: That these URLs answered at this instant from this runner. It does NOT prove that any number in this repository is current, that a value was parsed correctly, or that the source will still exist tomorrow. Reachability and currency are separate claims.

findings.detail: 751 cited URL(s) are refused to a non-browser client (401/403/429). Those values can only be checked by a human in a browser.
8/13 refused URL(s) answer when sent nba.com's own web-client headers. Those sources are script-readable with the right client, so an automated pipeline is possible for them.
